elements.label: Second presenter turning his head from off-camera toward the lens while speaking

pattern.description: A live-action interview shot of a second team member behind a laptop. On 'In the new Cursor,' he turns his head from an off-camera interlocutor toward the lens.
pattern.why_premium: A documentary interview setup (shallow focus on a bookshelf background, a laptop as a foreground layer, the subject's eyeline moving to the lens) makes the launch feel candid and human rather than scripted.

build_hint.gsap: Not an animation: live-action footage. Place the clip on its own track with no tweens.
build_hint.remotion: Use <OffthreadVideo> for the footage. No animated properties.

notes: Camera move is none. The many small diff boxes on the bookshelf (b02 to b19) are background shimmer or slight handheld drift from the presenter's movement, not separate moving elements. The scale of 1.0108 may hint at a very slow drift, but the camera verdict says none. No SFX candidates.
